title: Peak global population and other key findings from the 2024 UN World Population Prospects
book_use: Chapter 9; The Shrinking Century; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: comparison of recent UN projection rounds; 2024 revision moved the expected peak lower and earlier relative to earlier projections; Limits: Use revision history as evidence that forecasts change, not as evidence that future revisions must continue in the same direction.
